about: Benefit values where the 2027 plan brochure (the plan's official statement of benefits) disagrees with OPM's benefits spreadsheet and the brochure was checked by hand. pipeline/build_data.py applies each entry to data/benefits.json: the engine field gets the brochure value, the listed raw fields show the brochure text, and benefits[code].overrides keeps the spreadsheet value, page, quote and reason (the app shows a 'Differs from OPM spreadsheet' badge). Each entry's 'sheet' must equal the spreadsheet value or the build stops.

overrides.quote: The calendar year deductible for the Basic Option is $4,800 per person.

also.quote: The calendar year deductible for Basic Option is: $4,800 per person ($9,600 per Self Plus One enrollment, or $9,600 per Self and Family enrollment).

overrides.reason: Every mention in the Sharp Health Plan brochure (Section 4 page 24, the Basic Option overview page 29, Section 5 pages 31, 48 and 56; page numbers are the PDF pages of the brochure text file) gives $4,800 per person / $9,600 for Self Plus One and Self and Family; $5,500 appears nowhere in it. The out-of-pocket maximums ($8,100 / $16,200) agree with the spreadsheet. The brochure is the plan's official statement of benefits.

overrides.quote: $5 per generic maintenance drug prescription
overrides.reason: The brochure prints no tier numbers; its Standard column lists $5 (generic maintenance) then $15 (all other generics) and the spreadsheet carries the same two prices with the numbers reversed (its own High Option row numbers them the other way).

overrides.quote: $15 for all other generic drug prescriptions
overrides.reason: The brochure prints no tier numbers; its Standard column lists $5 (generic maintenance) then $15 (all other generics) and the spreadsheet carries the same two prices with the numbers reversed.

overrides.brochure_text: 25% Coinsurance up to $500 per prescription - specialty drugs
overrides.quote: Tier 4 (Specialty Drugs): 25% up to $500 per prescription or refill
overrides.reason: The brochure has only four tiers and Tier 4 is Specialty at 25% up to $500; the spreadsheet puts that 25% specialty price in its Tier 5 and fills its Tier 4 slot with a tier the brochure does not have (50%).

overrides.brochure_text: 30% Coinsurance up to $500 per prescription - specialty drugs
overrides.quote: Tier 4 (Specialty Drugs): 30% up to $500 per prescription or refill
overrides.reason: Basic column Tier 4 (Specialty) is 30% up to $500; the spreadsheet puts the 30% in its Tier 5 and fills Tier 4 with a tier the brochure does not have (50%).

overrides.brochure_text: 50% Coinsurance up to $500 per prescription - specialty drugs
overrides.quote: Tier 4 - Specialty Pharmaceuticals 50% of the plan allowance up to a maximum out-of-pocket of $500 per prescription
overrides.reason: The brochure states 50% (capped at $500 per prescription) for Tier 4 Specialty; the spreadsheet's 100% coinsurance is not supported anywhere in the brochure.

overrides.quote: Non-Preferred Specialty drugs: $200 copayment
overrides.reason: The High column (printed first) shows $200 for Non-Preferred Specialty and the Standard column $250; the spreadsheet's JK1 value of $250 is the Standard Option price.

overrides.quote: Tier 2 (Non-Preferred Generic) $25 Tier 3 (Preferred Brand) $65 Tier 4 (Non-Preferred Brand) $120 Tier 5 (Preferred Generic Specialty) 20%, up to a maximum of $400
overrides.reason: The Basic block (printed second, after Standard) is $8/$25/$65/$120/20% (up to $400)/$400/$600; the extraction matches it and the spreadsheet's Basic row ($20/$60/30%/injectable 50%) does not.

overrides.quote: Tier 2 (Non-Preferred Generic) $25 Tier 3 (Preferred Brand) $65 Tier 4 (Non-Preferred Brand) $120 Tier 5 (Preferred Generic Specialty) 20%, up to a maximum of $400
overrides.reason: Retail $65 is right (Basic block) and the spreadsheet's $60 is wrong, but the extraction took the 90-day mail price from the Summary ($187.50) while Section 5(f) page 67 and the Section 2 change notice (page 18, $150 to $162.50) both give $162.50 for Basic.

overrides.quote: Tier 2 (Non-Preferred Generic) $25 Tier 3 (Preferred Brand) $65 Tier 4 (Non-Preferred Brand) $120 Tier 5 (Preferred Generic Specialty) 20%, up to a maximum of $400
overrides.reason: Retail $120 is right (Basic block) and the spreadsheet's 30% is wrong, but the extraction took the mail price from the Summary ($500) while the Basic column of Section 5(f) page 67 (second of three blocks) shows a flat $300.

overrides.reason: The Basic block (printed second, after Standard) is $8/$25/$65/$120/20% (up to $400)/$400/$600; the extraction matches it and the spreadsheet's Basic row ($20/$60/30%/injectable 50%) does not.

overrides.quote: Tier 1 (Preferred Generic) $8 Tier 2 (Non-Preferred Generic) $20 Tier 3 (Preferred Brand) 30%, up to a maximum of a $75 copay
overrides.reason: The page prints three separate blocks in header order Standard, Basic, Value; the Standard block is $8/$20/30%/50%/20% (up to $400)/$400/$600 and the spreadsheet's Standard row ($5/$18, its Tier 5 being the $400 Tier 6 price) disagrees; the Value option, which matches the spreadsheet exactly, confirms the column order.
